newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IFO index comes in below expectations.
newsitem.headline: German IFO index comes in below expectations.

text.p: Germany's IFO economics institute on Thursday released data showing that confidence in the German economy was less strong than expected.
The west German business climate index fell to 92.4 in March, compared with 93.6 in February, far below expectations for a figure of around 94.0.
In East Germany, the business climate was unchanged at 104.1.
Economists said the fall was bigger than expected.
Karen Kricks-Brunnlieb at Trinkaus & Burkhardt said in an initial reaction. "We had forecast a decline but this drop is bigger than we had expected.
"But it is not that surprisaing given that the dollar weakened slightly in March and because of uncertainty about the outcome of discussions about corporate tax reform," she added.

Wolfram Roddewig, European economist at Schroders in London said, "The figures are very disappointing for west Germany, where they are down quite sharply... There is still a lack of the momentum needed to generate growth and create employment."
